description: Comment "Photo" and I'll send you all the prompts 👇 What happens when you ask ChatGPT to find every photo of you on the internet? I tried this and it found me in photos I didn't even know existed. Prompt 1: Upload a selfie and say: "Analyze this photo and list out every specific feature that makes me recognizable so you can identify me anywhere online." ChatGPT builds a full description of exactly what you look like. Here's the trick: Turn on Agent Mode and say: "Using my selfie and everything you know about me, go reverse image search my face across the top tools and find every single place I appear on the internet and give me a link to each one." ChatGPT opens its own browser, runs your face through every reverse image search, and comes back with a link to every place you show up. The results were terrifying. Bonus (if you value your privacy): "Now write me custom removal requests for each of these sites to get my photos taken down." ChatGPT writes custom takedown requests for every single photo. Be safe out there. #chatgpt #ai #privacy #chatgptprompts #aitools
